status: preregistered before benchmark implementation, compilation, or measurement
purpose: Measure whether reusing the oneDNN primitive descriptor and matmul primitive materially reduces the dominant c96 Qwen3.8-27B gate/up GEMM cost before changing the llama.cpp backend.
scope: Mechanism-only real-shape microbenchmark; no timing or rate from this test is an endpoint or publishable model result.
hardware: Each of the two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards tested separately; no remote host.
shape: Deterministic f16xf16->f32 oneDNN matmul with A=[1,8704,5120], B=[1,5120,96], C=[1,8704,96], matching the dominant c96 ffn_gate/ffn_up group in the r22 endpoint profile.
arms: Reconstruct the memory descriptors, primitive attributes, primitive descriptor and matmul primitive for every execution versus reuse only the descriptors, primitive descriptor and matmul primitive; both arms still construct pointer-bound memory objects, the scratchpad memory wrapper and argument map per execution, as a backend cache cannot assume stable tensor pointers.
method: Allocate and initialize once; prewarm oneDNN; alternate arm order across timed blocks; include submission and an explicit queue wait; execute multiple invocations per sample; report per-invocation median and interquartile ranges.
correctness_gate: The cached-plan and reconstruct-every-call output buffers must be byte-identical after timed execution on each card.
advance_rule: Only implement a default-off backend primitive cache if both local cards pass byte identity and cached-plan median time is at least 5% lower than reconstruct-every-call. Otherwise close primitive reuse as unsupported by this evidence.
profile_basis: r22 recorded 16,256 gate/up calls per GPU at median 0.236816 ms on GPU0 and attributed 42.51% of its oneDNN execution time to this group; GPU1 was comparable. Wrapper-side object construction is not included in oneDNN execution records.
claim_policy: Even a passing mechanism result only authorizes a scoped endpoint candidate. Promotion still requires fresh-server, prompt-cache-off, 96/96 exact-oracle endpoint repeats under the strict c96 policy.
